comment: Every third-party input of the Windows x64 build, pinned by SHA-256 and size. scripts/windows/fetch_inputs.py refuses any file whose hash differs. Where an upstream publishes its own digest it is named in 'checked_against'; those digests were compared when the pin was made. A pin changes only in a reviewed commit.

vlc-win64.role: runtime: official VLC for Windows; libvlc.dll and the Blu-ray plugin are replaced by the patched build when one is staged
vlc-win64.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (VLC); LGPL-2.1-or-later (libvlc, libvlccore, most plugins); see COPYING.txt inside the archive

vlc-src.role: build: source of the patched libvlc.dll and Blu-ray plugin (patches/vlc-3.0.23)

libbluray-src.role: build: libbluray linked into the patched Blu-ray plugin; its BD-J jars replace the stock 1.4.0 pair

transmission-msi.role: runtime: transmission-daemon.exe and the DLLs it imports
transmission-msi.license: GPL-2.0-only or GPL-3.0-only, with an OpenSSL linking exception (see COPYING in the source tag); bundled libcurl: curl licence; OpenSSL 3: Apache-2.0; zlib: zlib licence

tailscale-msi.role: runtime: tailscale.exe and tailscaled.exe (started with --tun=userspace-networking, so wintun.dll is not staged)
tailscale-msi.license: BSD-3-Clause (Tailscale); Go standard library and modules under their own licences

temurin-jre.role: runtime: Java for BD-J menus (JAVA_HOME is set to resources/jre)
temurin-jre.license: GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception; the archive carries NOTICE and legal/

vc-redist-x64.role: runtime: source of the app-local Visual C++ runtime DLLs placed next to the Transmission daemon (extracted with 7-Zip, never executed)
vc-redist-x64.license: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable licence terms (shipped as licenses/microsoft-vc-redist-license.rtf, extracted from the bundle itself); legal review of app-local redistribution is an open item
vc-redist-x64.checked_against: Microsoft's download URL embeds this hash; the file is Authenticode-signed by Microsoft

webview2-offline-x64.version: stand-alone installer served by https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124701 on 2026-10-28 (file dated 2026-10-26)
webview2-offline-x64.role: installer: offline WebView2 runtime for machines without it; embedded in the NSIS installer
webview2-offline-x64.license: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime licence terms
webview2-offline-x64.checked_against: Authenticode signature by Microsoft (verify on Windows with Get-AuthenticodeSignature); Microsoft rotates this GUID path, so an expired URL means a deliberate re-pin, not a silent update

license-transmission.role: licence text: Transmission (the MSI carries none)

license-tailscale.role: licence text: Tailscale (the MSI carries none)

license-curl.role: licence text: libcurl.dll inside the Transmission MSI (PE version resource: 8.16.0)

license-openssl.role: licence text: libcrypto-3-x64.dll and libssl-3-x64.dll inside the Transmission MSI (PE version resource: 3.5.4)

license-zlib.role: licence text: zlib.dll inside the Transmission MSI (PE version resource: 1.3.1)

sevenzip-linux-x64.role: tool: cabinet and Burn-bundle extraction when staging on Linux (Windows runners use their own 7-Zip)
sevenzip-linux-x64.checked_against: GitHub release asset digest (gh api repos/ip7z/7zip/releases)
